messages:
Maya (partnerships): Heads-up: CirrusCloud wants to co-host a "Whats new in edge inference" webinar at our booth during CloudStack conf. Need speakers, demo order, marketplace blurb, and swag split. Whos in? :wave:
Jin (devrel): I can prep the tutorial notebook and live colab link. Prefer live demo of model serving from Redwood Dedicated -> Cirrus edge node.
Rafael (CirrusCloud): Cirrus can provide 2 edge appliances and 1 rack unit for the booth demo. Well also share a slide about the marketplace listing process.
Noor (product): For the marketplace blurb we need a 75-word summary + 2 screenshots. Can someone draft the 75-word blurb by Thu?
Priya (solutions): I'll draft the blurb and proposed marketplace tags (edge, private-deploy, low-latency). Also will prepare fallback demo (video) in case network flops.
Sam (events): Booth logistics: power will be limited to 1500W per vendor. We need to confirm the power draw of Cirrus units. Also confirm how many staff passes for partner reps? 3?
Rafael (CirrusCloud): Each appliance ~400W peak. 2 units + router ~900W. 3 partner passes sounds good.
Jin (devrel): Demo run order suggestion: 1) Redwood intro (Maya, 4m) 2) Marketplace announcement + partner slide (Rafael, 3m) 3) Live cold start demo (Jin, 7m) 4) Warm cache rerun (Noor, 4m) 5) Q&A w/ audience (Priya, 7m). Can we keep total talk to 25m + 5m buffer?
Maya (partnerships): That order works. Need a dry-run Wed 3pm PT. Sam can you reserve a room and Zoom?
Sam (events): Room booked: West Conf B. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (PW in invite). Dry-run invites sent.
Design Bot: Reminder: upload co-branded hero (1200x627 PNG) and one-pager to /shared/marketing/assets by Thurs COB.
Priya (solutions): Swag plan: split budget with Cirrus 60/40. Proposal: 150 stickers (co-branded), 200 lanyards, 80 insulated tumblers, and 40 pre-burned USB drives containing the demo notebook. Thoughts?
Rafael (CirrusCloud): OK on split. Cirrus will handle lanyards + tumblers. Redwood to handle USB drives and stickers.
Noor (product): Quick note for speakers: emphasize routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> private edge) and how customers can pin model versions in Dedicated. Avoid heavy infra slides.
Jin (devrel): CLI smoke commands for the demo (put in runbook):
```
# warm cache preload
redwoodctl serve --model gpt-2-lite --target cirrus-node-01 --preload weights_v3.tar.gz
# run test prompt
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-2-lite","prompt":"Summarize the architecture"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Maya (partnerships): Legal needs to approve co-marketing copy. Ill ping Legal for a short SLA on the marketplace listing and a joint press blurb.
Sam (events): AV needs: 1x HDMI split, 2x wireless mics, 1x small UPS for demo rack. Vendor requires request by Fri noon.
Priya (solutions): I'll assemble the runbook and include the fallback video + step-by-step for onsite engineers. Will share by Tue noon.
Maya (partnerships): Action recap: Priya: marketplace blurb + runbook (Tue noon). Jin: demo notebook + runbook snippets (Tue). Design Bot: co-branded hero + one-pager (Thu COB). Sam: room/zoom booked + AV order (done/book AV by Fri noon). Rafael: confirm appliance serials & ship date (Thu). Legal: review copy (ASAP). Dry-run Wed 3pm PT. Thanks all :raised_hands:
